create_threshold_reward_preprocessor: create a ThresholdReward preprocessor that outputs hi when reward is at or above a threshold and lo otherwise
create_l2_reward_preprocessor: create an L2Reward preprocessor that computes negative L2 distance between two observations scaled and offset
create_thresholded_l2_reward_preprocesso: create a ThresholdedL2Reward preprocessor that gives a fixed reward when L2 distance between two observations is below a threshold
create_compute_reward_preprocessor: create a ComputeReward preprocessor that applies a custom lambda function to observations to compute a scalar reward
create_filter_reward_with_consecutive_fi: create a FilterReward preprocessor with a ConsecutiveValueFilter that only passes rewards after N consecutive identical values
create_filter_reward_with_stacked_filter: create a FilterReward preprocessor with a StackedRewardsFilter that rewards when the last K rewards are all above a threshold
create_combine_rewards_with_strategy: create a CombineRewards preprocessor that combines multiple reward preprocessors using max, min, sum, or a custom strategy
create_staged_with_active_threshold: create a StagedWithActiveThreshold combination strategy that rewards proportionally to the number of sub-rewards above a threshold
create_staged_with_success_threshold: create a StagedWithSuccessThreshold combination strategy that focuses reward on the first unsolved stage below a threshold
